mapper.select: SELECT distinct smr.business_number, smr.max_fall_range_id, smr_h.history_index, smr.operator_id, smr.identifier, smr.internal_identifier, smr.swim_id, smr.enable, smr.update_at, smr.create_at FROM swim_max_fall_range smr INNER JOIN swim_max_fall_range_history smr_h ON smr.business_number = smr_h.business_number AND smr.max_fall_range_id = smr_h.max_fall_range_id INNER JOIN swim_feedback f ON smr_h.business_number = f.business_number AND smr_h.max_fall_range_id = f.max_fall_range_id AND smr_h.history_index = f.history_index WHERE smr.business_number = #{businessNumber} AND smr.max_fall_range_id = #{maxFallRangeId} AND smr.enable = true ORDER BY smr.business_number ASC, smr.max_fall_range_id ASC, smr_h.history_index ASC

SELECT smr.business_number, smr.max_fall_range_id, smr_h.history_index, smr.operator_id, smr.identifier, smr.internal_identifier, smr.swim_id, smr.enable, smr.update_at, smr.create_at FROM swim_max_fall_range smr INNER JOIN swim_max_fall_range_history smr_h ON smr.business_number = smr_h.business_number AND smr.max_fall_range_id = smr_h.max_fall_range_id INNER JOIN ( select business_number, max_fall_range_id, max(history_index) as history_index from swim_max_fall_range_history group by business_number, max_fall_range_id ) m ON m.business_number = smr.business_number AND m.max_fall_range_id = smr.max_fall_range_id AND m.history_index = smr_h.history_index WHERE smr.business_number = #{businessNumber} AND smr.max_fall_range_id = #{maxFallRangeId} AND smr.enable = true

SELECT smr.business_number, smr.max_fall_range_id, smr_h.history_index, smr.operator_id, smr.identifier, smr.internal_identifier, smr.swim_id, smr.enable, smr.update_at, smr.create_at FROM swim_max_fall_range smr INNER JOIN swim_max_fall_range_history smr_h ON smr.business_number = smr_h.business_number AND smr.max_fall_range_id = smr_h.max_fall_range_id INNER JOIN swim_feedback f ON smr_h.business_number = f.business_number AND smr_h.max_fall_range_id = f.max_fall_range_id AND smr_h.history_index = f.history_index WHERE smr.business_number = #{businessNumber} AND smr.max_fall_range_id = #{maxFallRangeId} AND smr.enable = true AND f.history_index = #{historyIndex}
